description: This file defines a FeedGenerator class for creating and managing MISP event feeds, including handling templates, event creation, attribute addition, object addition, and manifest management. It interacts with external modules like pymisp and settings, and manages files such as manifest.json and hashes.csv.

classes.name: FeedGenerator
classes.description: Helper class to create and manage daily MISP feeds, including event creation, attribute/object addition, and manifest handling.

methods.name: get_system_templates
methods.description: Fetches all MISP object templates present on the local system by reading JSON definitions from the misp-objects directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FeedGenerator instance, loads templates, sets up event parameters, and retrieves the last event from the manifest.

methods.name: add_sighting_on_attribute
methods.description: Stub method for adding a sighting on an attribute; currently not supported.

methods.name: add_attribute_to_event
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the current event, updates hashes, and manages event state.

methods.name: add_object_to_event
methods.description: Adds an object to the current event based on a template, filling attributes from provided data.

methods.name: _after_addition
methods.description: Handles post-addition tasks such as flushing the event to disk if the flushing interval has elapsed.

methods.name: _add_hash
methods.description: Adds a hash of an attribute value to the attributeHashes list, handling special cases with '|' or 'malware-sample'.

methods.name: _init_manifest
methods.description: Initializes the manifest file and creates the first event.

methods.name: flush_event
methods.description: Writes the current event to disk and saves hashes.

methods.name: save_manifest
methods.description: Saves the current manifest to disk.

methods.name: save_hashes
methods.description: Saves accumulated attribute hashes to a CSV file.

methods.name: get_last_event_from_manifest
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent event from the manifest, or initializes a new one if none exists.

methods.name: update_daily_event_id
methods.description: Checks if the date has changed and creates a new event if necessary.

methods.name: _get_event_from_id
methods.description: Loads an event from disk given its UUID.

methods.name: create_daily_event
methods.description: Creates a new daily event, references organization info, and saves it.
